nodes.label: ToolInputRequirementMatrix
nodes.rationale: Canonical policy for requiredness gating across all Tool input source families (direct-input, tool-input-file, api-acquisition). Start eligibility is deterministic: all always-required or required-by-tool-setting entries must be satisfied before start; optional entries never block start. Extends ToolInputFileRequirementPolicy.

nodes.label: ToolInputSourceFamily
nodes.rationale: Value Object classifying the source family of a Tool input entry: direct-input (user-typed fields), tool-input-file (uploaded files: BriefingFile, AngleDetectorFile), api-acquisition (retrieval from persisted ApiService definitions). Enumeration backbone of ToolInputRequirementMatrixEntry.sourceFamily.

nodes.label: WorkflowStepType
nodes.rationale: Canonical Value Object for execution strategy category of a WorkflowStep. Values: extraction (LLM-driven structured extraction), generation (LLM-driven content production), acquisition (external API data retrieval), crawling (web scraping/SERP extraction), scoring (competitor domain grouping). Extensible catalog enabling new execution strategies without changing orchestration.

nodes.label: GEOMETRIC Tool Identity
nodes.rationale: ToolKey=geometric, DisplayName=GEOMETRIC, ToolWorkflow=geometric_analysis. Chains 4 WorkflowSteps: serp-crawling (crawling) -> competitor-scoring (scoring) -> strategic-reporting (generation) -> unified-report (generation, final). Direct-input-only tool with three required fields: base_query, language, country.

nodes.label: AnalysisSession Aggregate Root
nodes.rationale: Parallel aggregate root to GenerationSession for multi-query analysis cycles. Groups artifacts from a QueryCluster (one BaseQuery + derived PAAQuery entries). Carries sessionId, projectId, userId, toolKey, baseQuery, language, country, artifact membership.

nodes.label: QueryCluster / BaseQuery / PAAQuery
nodes.rationale: QueryCluster is the complete set of queries for one AnalysisSession: one BaseQuery (user-entered) plus up to four PAAQuery entries (Google People Also Ask correlated queries). Both are Value Objects scoped to AnalysisSession. PAA queries derived during crawling phase, max 4 to limit parallel crawl count.

nodes.label: GeoScore and CompetitorTier Internal Types
nodes.rationale: GeoScore (numeric visibility score 1-10) and CompetitorTier (TIER_1 Dominators, TIER_2 Constant Presence, TIER_3 Niche Sources) are internal to CompetitorAnalysisContext. Not exposed via contracts — data flows through artifact content boundary (JSON serialization) rather than type imports to prevent downstream coupling.

nodes.label: CompetitorAnalysisContext Bounded Context
nodes.rationale: New bounded context for grouping raw extraction data, identifying competitor domains, classifying sources, computing weighted GeoScore values, and assigning CompetitorTier. Produces CompetitorRanking aggregate per AnalysisSession. Downstream of CrawlingAndExtractionContext, upstream of Generation. Scoring logic is GEOMETRIC-specific to prevent pollution of Generation context.

nodes.label: CrawlingAndExtractionContext Bounded Context
nodes.rationale: New bounded context for asynchronous web crawling, SERP scraping, anti-bot bypass, and structured data extraction. Produces CrawlingJob aggregate and QueryExtraction entity. Upstream of Generation, downstream of Auth/Usage. Crawling step exposed as reusable WorkflowStepType='crawling'.

nodes.label: GenerationRequestAssembly Application Layer Process
nodes.rationale: Application-Layer Process that translates accumulated FE session state (HydrationResult, ExtractionContext, ToolStep) into a GenerationRequest command. Runs in Frontend runtime but produces a BE-owned domain command. Not a Domain Service and not a Value Object — it is a boundary-crossing translation process.
